artifact_checks.article_and_explore: Exact three reviewed srcset variants in every edition.
artifact_checks.hills_and_destinations: Existing cards use the unchanged original JPEG without srcset; independent initial blanket-srcset assertion was corrected after inspecting this actual intended markup. No implementation defect.

helper_review.local_gaps: Closed: fixed original SHA, frozen manuscript contract/stage hashes, exact native-link contract, actual decoder dimensions.
helper_review.live_gaps: Corrected incoming-card text/alt/srcset coverage and filename-prefix checks verified in code.
helper_review.comparison_helper: Inspected compare-live-images.mjs. It requires completed four-route HTTP evidence; reads each recorded image pair; pins bytes to raw hashes; validates content-addressed names; compares geometry; records decoded RGB and metadata deltas only for unequal bytes; retains raw report hash; never automatically accepts visual differences or attributes an encoding cause.
helper_review.remaining_obligation: At live delivery independently confirm all actual article/card image URLs are represented (current local set is 11 unique files), responsive descriptors match decoded geometry, and visually review any differences. The comparison helper alone does not prove exhaustive collection.
